title_zh: 按证据限制削弱报告建议的力度

scenario.label_zh: 按证据限制削弱报告建议的力度
scenario.goal_zh: 区分局部证据缺陷与全盘否定并约定调低建议强度并说明适用范围

context_zh: 两位研究课学生讨论虚构活动评估报告，样本只有六次访谈；不作现实政策或专业决策。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Tobin
sentences.text: Does the small sample undermine the whole report?

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: Not wholly. The six interviews still contain useful observations; they just don't represent everyone.

sentences.speaker: Tobin
sentences.text: Then the problem is our recommendation to change every branch at once.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: Yes. We should weaken that recommendation and suggest a small pilot instead.

sentences.speaker: Tobin
sentences.text: I'll make that change and state exactly who we interviewed.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: That keeps the useful evidence without making it carry more weight than it can.
